changelog:
🔗 SSE 心跳保活：三条流式路径（Claude /v1/messages、OpenAI /v1/chat/completions、/v1/responses）在对客户端静默超过 15 秒时自动发送心跳——Claude 路径用 Anthropic 原生 ping 事件（官方流本就会发，客户端必然兼容），OpenAI/responses 路径用 SSE 注释行（规范要求解析器忽略）；消灭思考不转发、tool_use 输入缓冲、首 token 等待三类长静默窗口被 Cloudflare 等中间层 ~100 秒空闲读超时切断导致的无声断流。间隔可用环境变量 KIRO_SSE_KEEPALIVE_SECONDS 调整（0=关闭，默认 15）。
⚡ 响应头提前 flush：流式请求在上游拿到 2xx 后立即提交 200 响应头并启动心跳，不再等首个内容事件，修复大 prompt 冷缓存下 TTFB 超 100 秒触发的 CF 524；未出首内容时的换号重试语义不变（心跳在换号期间继续），头已发出后所有账号仍失败则以 SSE error 事件收尾。所有写出（事件+心跳+flush）经同一把写锁串行，handler 返回前确定性停止心跳。新增 /admin/api/status 与 /admin/api/stats 的 keepalivePings 计数用于线上观测。
🔗 SSE keepalive: all three streaming paths (Claude /v1/messages, OpenAI /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses) now emit a heartbeat whenever the stream has been silent towards the client for 15s — the Claude path uses the Anthropic-native ping event (official streams already send it, so every client is compatible), the OpenAI/responses paths use an SSE comment line (parsers must ignore it per spec). This kills the silent disconnects caused by middleboxes with ~100s idle-read timeouts (e.g. Cloudflare free plan) during the three known silent windows: swallowed reasoning, buffered tool_use input, and pre-first-token waits. Interval tunable via KIRO_SSE_KEEPALIVE_SECONDS (0=off, default 15).
⚡ Early header flush: streaming requests commit the 200 response headers and start the keepalive as soon as the upstream returns 2xx instead of waiting for the first content event, fixing CF 524s when cold-cache TTFB exceeded 100s; pre-first-content account failover is preserved (heartbeats continue across retries), and if every account fails after the headers went out the stream is closed with an SSE error event. Every write (events + heartbeats + flushes) is serialized behind one lock and the heartbeat is deterministically stopped before the handler returns. New keepalivePings counter on /admin/api/status and /admin/api/stats for live verification.
